answer.rationale: The degradation is regional and write-path specific; the released security patch cannot be rolled back. Memory b2 says regional failover restored latency quickly during the March degradation, with clean traffic shifts and error-rate recovery in minutes. Memory b5 concerns read-replica routing, which is not obviously useful for write-path latency, but I will review it to avoid mistakenly using it when the problem is writes. Regional failover is the best one intervention because it preserves the compliance-mandated release, avoids customer-write loss, and directly addresses region-scoped p99 degradation during peak settlement traffic.
